name: io.github.phasebro/phase
title: Phase Platforms
description: Phase: mint your own sovereign coin and browse the marketplace from your AI agent.

tools.name: show_coin_setup
tools.description: Show the interactive coin-setup widget: name, ticker, category, price, market cap, and ownership split with live supply math. The widget sends the chosen values back to the agent, which creates the draft — the widget itself never mints.

tools.name: show_agreement
tools.description: Show the sign-and-approve widget for a draft: the full agreement text, the deal recap (price, cap, total supply, retained/float counts), a legal-name input, an explicit agreement checkbox, then a final confirm card with Mint / Edit setup. Requires the user's Phase token.

tools.name: sign_agreement
tools.description: Sign a draft's Issuer Agreement. Widget-only: called from the agreement widget after the user checks the agreement box and types their legal name.

tools.name: mint_coin
tools.description: Mint a signed draft into a live coin. Widget-only: called from the agreement widget's final confirm card. Requires the issuer's Phase wallet address (ph1...) — resolved from the user's existing coins when not supplied.

tools.name: show_dashboard
tools.description: Show the interactive dashboard widget: balances, my coins with live positions and Phase Cred, open swap offers, watchlist, recent activity, and quick actions. Requires the user's Phase token.

tools.name: show_marketplace
tools.description: Show the interactive marketplace widget: search, category chips, band-themed coin cards with Phase Cred, coin detail with proof list, watch/unwatch, and buy. Public without a token; pass the user's Phase token for mine/watchlisted flags and buy/watch actions.

tools.name: set_watchlist
tools.description: Watch or unwatch a coin. Widget-only: called from the marketplace widget.
